Cool bar in Miami Beach
Mar 2026 • Couples
We love a good speakeasy vibe, and finding Swizzle was tough if you aren’t familiar with the area. Tucked away in the Stiles Hotel is the small intimate bar, Swizzle. 

We were seated in the main bar area and both ordered a beverage. I got the Amazonia, a gin based drink with agave lavender and lemon juice with a macha rim. Caleb got the El Presidente, which is a rum based drink with orange liqueur, vermouth, and pomegranate. The drinks were really good, and as expected in a place like this, a bit on the expensive side, but at Swizzle you have a mixologist preparing your cocktails, which always heightens the quality! 

It was nice to find an intimate place in Miami Beach to kick back enjoy a cocktail and just have some nice conversation, and some people watching with each other. We didn’t make a reservation and likely just hit the timing right, so we got in right away and had a great spot.

I was at Swizzle Rum & Drinkery and I loved the experience. 

It was my first time at this speakeasy, and liked everything from it : the vibes, the music, the service and of course the well-crafted cocktails. 

I started with their Mamey Swizzle where you get the best from two worlds, rum and mezcal. It was great.

I can see this place becoming one of my go-to bars in town.

reviews.review_text:
Sharksss13
New York City, New York71 contributions
0
A perfect speakeasy with a cocktail menu that will blow your mind.
Nov 2024 • Couples
Easily one of the best speakeasy’s I’ve ever been to, and as a resident of NYC that praise does not come lightly. 

The cocktail menu is very creative and incredibly diverse. For example, the Sip Bite Sip is served with goat cheese. Sound weird? It is until you taste it all together. All booze are amply represented from around the world and the bar tenders leverage them to the hilt. After having some adventure on the menu, I asked for a traditional daiquiri. It’s my benchmark cocktail wherever I go. I’ve had it on 3 continents and in over a dozen countries. This was, hands down, the best I’ve had. A perfect gem. 

The atmosphere laid back, but romantic, with traditional speakeasy charms. The staff is friendly and helpful in navigating the rich menu. 

My wife and I have now been several times, and it never disappoints. It is in our permanent South Beach itinerary. A must do.

Cheers.

reviews.review_text:
J E
Fredericksburg, Virginia15019 contributions

Now THIS is a Cocktail Bar!!!
Nov 2019
Long overdue for a speakeasy in South Beach! This place is very interesting… Finding it within the building is equally as interesting, as it’s on the lower of the Stiles Hotel, walk through the candlelit long vestibule and through the closed accordion doors on the left and you’ll find yourself in a cozy, very small, very dimly-lit space that it very comfy and will take you back in time to what speakeasy’s were probably like many years ago.
The staff in this place are all very friendly and accommodating and truly interested in ensuring you have an amazing experience while visiting. They are amazing at mixing cocktails and their cocktail list is large with many very unique drinks, most involving rum.
They even have a happy hour, from 7PM to 10PM each day with amazing prices, like half off their most amazing cocktail the Missionary’s Downfall. You’ve got to check out their prices and offerings for happy hour. It’s the best time to get one of the best Cubans I’ve ever had as well.
The mixer they use are all made in-house with fresh fruits and it’s evident in the flavor of the cocktails.
Been several times and definitely will keep returning when visiting Miami in the future!
